workspace.change_summary: Redesigned the Model Zoo catalog landing page with a registry overview, task/framework/modality metrics and quick modality filters, preserving existing routes and catalog data disclosures.

dependency_recovery.initial_failure: Pydantic 2.13.5 rejected the xlang3 profile's pydantic-core 2.50.1 as an incompatible version; a full requirements install attempted and failed while building pydantic-core.
dependency_recovery.resolution: Installed pure-Python pydantic 2.14.1 into the workspace .xlang3-site with xlang3 -m pip --no-deps, matching the profile's existing pydantic-core 2.50.1.
